messages:
Nina: Quick post-launch split: three customer reports in morning digest. Need fast call on bug vs enhancement so we can update customers.

Pat: List?

Nina: pasted from support:
```
RD-9620 - embeddings truncated for multi-file uploads (CustF)
RD-9633 - streaming jitter under burst (CustG)
RD-9640 - request-level ACL needed for workspace teams (multiple customers)
```

Rae: My take: RD-9620 looks like a regression -> bug P0. RD-9633 infra/batching -> P1 mitigation. RD-9640 is a product enhancement (design + security review).

Elliot: If RD-9620 is P0, owner needs quick repro. I can spare 1.5 dev-days for a hotfix + regression test.

Pat: Ops: RD-9633 quick mitigation = tighten batching window + backpressure signal. Deployable as config today; cost impact minimal.

Nina: Proposal: Sprint 1 (10 days): land RD-9620 hotfix (owner: Elliot), RD-9633 mitigation (owner: Pat) as ops flip, start RD-9640 API sketch in parallel. Sprint 2: full RD-9640 implementation + tests.

Rae: Acceptance criteria RD-9620: failing reproducer in harness, unit/regression test, 5% canary for 24h with no embed drop.

Elliot: Will open PR with repro attached by EOD tomorrow.

NotifBot: Ticket RD-9801 created by Nina: "post-launch split: RD-9620 hotfix + RD-9640 scoping"

Nina: PMs will draft customer notes: CustF = hotfix ETA sprint 1, CustG = mitigation live, follow-up infra work planned.

Pat: I'll schedule ops deploy and monitor metrics.

Rae: +1
